UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated user profile and login status stored in Firestore.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

email.description: Verified email address of the user.

disabilityProfile.description: Optional playful learning support profile chosen during student sign-up.

teachingProfiles.description: Optional list of up to 6 learning superpower profiles a teacher specializes in teaching.

loginCount.description: Total number of recorded logins for this user.

isLoggedIn.description: Whether the user currently has an active session.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the account was first created.

lastLoginAt.description: Server timestamp of the most recent login or session update.

LoginLog.title: LoginLog
LoginLog.description: Immutable audit record of an individual login session for a user.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

email.description: Verified email address used to log in.

displayName.description: Display name at the time of login.

status.description: Session lifecycle status; signed_out is terminal.

loggedInAt.description: Server timestamp when the login occurred.

signedOutAt.description: Optional server timestamp when the session was signed out.

StudyNote.title: StudyNote
StudyNote.description: Accessible study note attached by a teacher and persisted for students until deleted by the teacher.

content.description: Full accessible text content of the study note.

fileName.description: Optional original file name if uploaded from a text file.

uploadedBy.description: Display name of the teacher who published the note.

teacherUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the publishing teacher.

targetProfiles.description: Optional list of up to 6 student learning superpower profiles this note is intended for.

visibility.description: Publication state readable by authenticated students and teachers.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the note was published.

/users/{userId}.description: Private user profile and login metadata document, accessible only by the authenticated owner.

/users/{userId}/loginLogs/{logId}.description: Private subcollection recording each login event for the authenticated owner.

/studyNotes/{noteId}.description: Shared study notes published from the Teacher Portal and persisted for the Student Portal until deleted by the teacher.
